subject: Re: Scheduling the kickoff call
text:
Hi,

Sorry for the late reply - after your note below I realized I mixed up two things and wanted to fix it quickly. I have a conflicting commitment during the slot I originally suggested, and because it is the same time I told the other person last week, I cannot keep it. I checked again, and my calendar looks clearer on Thursday, but there may still be one short overlap around late afternoon. I also have a lab session I keep forgetting to count, which may make things awkward.

And I don't want you thinking this is how I handle everything. Even though we were classmates once, I still remember the group project where I lost the shared notes, so I should have caught this conflict earlier. I am still learning to separate friendly history from client scheduling, especially when the work starts feeling urgent.

Would it work if we moved our call later in the week? If Thursday fails, Friday morning might be better, though I may join from a quieter room because the shared study space is noisy. I can also send a few questions ahead of time so we do not waste the first ten minutes sorting logistics. If the new client intake form is still open, I can finish that first.

Thanks for understanding, and sorry again for not sorting this sooner. I do not want to reschedule repeatedly, but this does affect our original plan.
